lessons: Premise false: criterion 2 says to build ctx the way tests/integration/test_host_mechanical.py does. That fixture writes to disk and runs real git, and tests/integration/conftest.py blocks both with its I/O guard. The new test is not in REAL_IO_TESTS, and conftest.py is outside the fence.

tests/integration/test_host_mechanical.py and test_image_candidates_select.py are in DISK_IO_SKIP in tests/integration/conftest.py, so they are skipped. Criterion 4 counts them as passing evidence but they never run. Replace them with tests that actually run against the moved check stage.

Rewrite criterion 2 and the integration test: keep a real Driver and FakeLLM, but give stages.check git through GitFake from tests/git_fake.py and use in-memory file seams. The ticket must name the fs seam the meta fill reads from and writes to; if none exists, say so and add it to scope.

The other option is to put tests/integration/conftest.py in the fence and add the new test to REAL_IO_TESTS. Do that only if the ticket says why real git is required, since DISK_IO_SKIP's paved road is to move tests onto the in-memory fakes.
The stages.py move and tests/unit/test_check_stage_events.py are sound as written. Only the integration criterion (2) and the evidence list for criterion 4 need revising before the next attempt.
